DD should be made in favour of Commanding Officer 9 JAK LI payable at Public Fund Acct in Respect of 9 JAK LI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
